arg.activate: Request adding and selecting LMM; this does not mean it has been applied
arg.add_only: Add LMM without changing the current selection
arg.agent_dir: Explicit Pi agent directory; other instances are not guessed or read
arg.all: Include only installed, supported targets; updates also require management approval
arg.application_issuer: Confirmed HTTPS issuer; defaults to the management record or official origin
arg.cancel_pending: Cancel a pending operation only before commit or deletion of original files; confirm the original plan_id
arg.change: Exact change_id to restore, available from status history
arg.configuration: Restore native provider configuration; otherwise restore the managed program version
arg.dry_run: Create a plan without applying changes
arg.fix: Request approved LMM repairs without bypassing capability checks
arg.installation_id: Independent application instance ID; never shared with read-only CLI login or other applications
arg.instance: Explicit local instance root; remote and Docker instances are not scanned
arg.issuer: Trusted LMM HTTPS origin; set explicitly for a self-hosted server
arg.json: Write JSON without CLI prompts or configuration contents
arg.lang: Display language: en or zh-CN; overrides LMM_LANG and locale variables
arg.managed_root: LMM-owned program directory, separate from application data selected by --instance
arg.model_id: Exact catalog model for unattended use; interactive setup can select from the catalog
arg.no_browser: Print the login URL; the browser must still reach this machine through loopback
arg.node: Explicit absolute path to Node (Pi adapter only)
arg.non_interactive: Do not wait for input when a target or authorization is missing
arg.pi_package: Root of the installed official Pi 1.2.0 npm package (Pi adapter only)
arg.plan_id: Confirm the exact previously previewed plan; reject execution if state changed
arg.query: Search text; omit to list all entries
arg.report: Create a shareable report without paths or configuration contents
arg.software: Exact catalog ID, such as astrbot or cc-switch
arg.timeout: Maximum wait for the browser callback, in seconds
arg.yes: Approve the displayed scope, not account changes, provider switches, or paid tests

auth.not_logged_in: Not signed in; run lmm login first

binding.authorization: A valid independent CC Switch model grant belonging to this instance is required
binding.confirm: Confirm the exact plan_id of the current preview
binding.conflict: The target changed, a same-name item exists or a native database write is in progress; preview again

cli.about: LMM: managed CC Switch installations and independent grants, native Pi integration
cmd.authorize: Approve an independent application grant in a browser; the read-only CLI login is not reused
cmd.balance: Read the current account balance, preserving server integer credits and USD units
cmd.catalog: Search the software catalog; entries are not verified integrations
cmd.credential: For Codex's native auth.command credential pipe only
cmd.disconnect: Disconnect an explicitly selected integration and its independent application grant
cmd.doctor: Run read-only checks; --fix still requires adapter support and approval
cmd.install: Preview or apply an explicitly confirmed managed software installation; LMM login is not required
cmd.login: Sign in with a browser and store credentials in the system vault
cmd.logout: Sign out of the CLI without revoking other application grants
cmd.models: Read authorized models and prices without calling or selecting a model
cmd.presets: Search the built-in provider snapshot without reading credentials or using the network
cmd.receipt: Query an immutable native configuration receipt without repeating a write
cmd.restore: Restore an explicit managed change or native configuration receipt while preserving later edits
cmd.run: Request a launch with the selected software configuration
cmd.setup: Preview integration and apply only a supported, explicitly authorized adapter
cmd.status: Inspect local environment and path evidence without making changes
cmd.sync: Refresh supported LMM configuration while preserving the current provider and model
cmd.uninstall: Plan removal of managed software; keep user data by default
cmd.update: Plan updates for software explicitly placed under management
